_readme: DRAFT — every cell below was seeded from general knowledge of the
Consolidated Zoning & Subdivision Ordinance of Marion County and MUST be
verified against the ordinance use tables before this goes public.
Structure: for each use, 'P' lists districts where it is permitted by
right, 'S' lists districts where it needs a special exception (BZA).
Any district not listed = not allowed = rezoning / variance-of-use path.
District codes should match MapIndy's zoning field after normalization
(uppercased, spaces stripped). Add or remove districts freely; the page
reads this file on load, so calibration never requires touching build.html.

uses.label: Single-family home (detached)
uses.note: Verify whether D-9 and the MU districts permit detached single-family by right.

uses.label: Accessory dwelling unit (ADU)
uses.note: DRAFT — check §744 secondary/accessory dwelling standards; owner-occupancy and size limits apply.

uses.label: Duplex (two-family)
uses.note: Verify the lowest D district permitting two-family by right.

uses.label: Apartments (5+ units)
uses.note: Check dwellings-in-commercial-districts rules (upper-floor residential in C districts).

uses.label: Home daycare (child care home)
uses.note: Accessory to an occupied dwelling; state registration and child-count caps apply — verify thresholds.

uses.label: Daycare center (child care center)
uses.note: Special exception in dwelling districts is the classic BZA case — outdoor play area and drop-off standards apply.

uses.label: Corner store / small retail
uses.note: The Zoning Gap headline use — ~60.7% of analyzed land bans it.

uses.label: Grocery store
uses.note: Verify floor-area limits in C-3 / MU-1.

uses.label: Restaurant / café
uses.note: Drive-through service typically needs a higher district or approval — treated separately.

uses.label: Brewery with taproom
uses.note: Production scale usually decides the district — verify artisan-scale carve-outs.

uses.label: Church / place of worship
uses.note: Marion County historically requires a rezoning to SU-1 for religious uses — a major, recurring rezoning category. Verify current RLUIPA-era treatment.

uses.label: School (K-12)
uses.note: Like worship: SU-2 rezoning is the standard path. Verify SE availability in dwelling districts.

uses.label: Light manufacturing / maker space
uses.note: Verify whether small artisan production is allowed in MU-3/MU-4.
